name: IM Creator
description_en:
IM Creator is a visual website builder based on reusable sections and content blocks. Its standard hosted editor serves individual sites, while Creator PRO offers a branded reseller dashboard and separately priced external-hosting or server-control arrangements. The homepage also advertises IM COSMOS as a beta; that newer product’s capabilities should not be assigned automatically to the established IM Creator/XPRS plans.

The practical decision is whether you need a simple hosted site, a conditional free license or a client-site business under your own brand. Public pages disagree about free hosting/domain rights and white-label prices. Establish the exact product, license, storage, SSL and renewal quote before subscribing rather than relying on the broad “free for all” headline.
description_zh:
IM Creator 是基于可复用区块和内容模块的可视化建站工具。标准托管编辑器面向单个网站，Creator PRO 提供品牌化转售管理面板，并另有外部托管或服务器控制方案。首页还宣传处于 beta 的 IM COSMOS，不能将这个新产品的能力自动归入既有 IM Creator/XPRS 方案。

实际选择取决于需要普通托管站、有条件免费许可，还是以自己的品牌经营客户网站。公开页面在免费托管/域名权利及白标价格方面有冲突。订阅前应确认具体产品、许可、存储、SSL 和续费报价，不能只依据“所有人免费”的标题。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose a design, mix sections and edit content without writing code; publication and domain selection are separate steps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择设计、混合区块并编辑内容，无需编写代码；发布和域名选择是独立步骤。

core_features.explanation_en: Creator PRO describes a client/site dashboard, own templates and prices, and client-specific logins; deeper hosting/API options have separate packages.
core_features.explanation_zh: Creator PRO 描述客户/站点面板、自有模板和价格及客户专属登录；更深入的托管/API 能力属于独立方案。

core_features.explanation_en: The white-label page distinguishes downloadable client sites from a customized builder on the customer’s server; neither implies an open-source license.
core_features.explanation_zh: 白标页区分可下载客户站点与在客户服务器部署定制建站器，两者均不等于开源许可。

pricing.summary_en: Free table lists 50MB and a platform URL; other copy conflicts. Premium shows $7.95/month on a one-year term and $9.95/month labeled Biannual. White-label entry pricing conflicts; obtain a written current quote.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费表列 50MB 与平台 URL，其他文案有冲突。Premium 一年期显示 $7.95/月，Biannual 显示 $9.95/月；白标入门报价冲突，应取得当前书面报价。

sections.title_en: Identify the editor before starting a site
sections.title_zh: 先确认编辑器再开始建站
sections.en:
For the established IM Creator workflow, choose a template, add or rearrange responsive sections, replace content and inspect the site on target devices. The official publishing guide describes the top toolbar’s Publish options for a temporary URL, an existing domain or a new domain, followed by license selection and payment where applicable. This guide is dated March 2019; confirm the current interface rather than treating its screens as a tested 2026 procedure. The homepage’s COSMOS beta advertises AI, CMS, eCommerce and hosting freedom as a distinct invitation, not proof that every standard account now includes them.

Primary evidence: [Publishing Your Site | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778301-publishing-your-site).
sections.zh:
既有 IM Creator 流程是选择模板、增删或重排响应式区块、替换内容，再检查目标设备展示。官方发布指南描述顶部工具栏的临时 URL、已有域名和新域名选项，之后选择许可并按需付款。指南日期为 2019 年 3 月，应确认当前界面，不能当作已实测的 2026 操作。首页 COSMOS beta 宣传 AI、CMS、电商和自由托管，是独立的新产品邀请，不证明每个标准账户都已包含这些能力。

一手依据：[Publishing Your Site | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778301-publishing-your-site)。

sections.en:
The dedicated pricing table says Free uses an imxprs.com/free/username URL, allows up to 50 MB and provides no email addresses. The 2019 cost FAQ repeats the 50 MB limit and directs custom-domain/larger-site users to a subscription. In contrast, the homepage and lower pricing-page copy advertise unlimited hosting/bandwidth and free domain connection; the homepage also presents a free-license application specifically for students, artists and nonprofits. The application URL only exposed a login screen in this read. Do not classify unrestricted free custom-domain hosting as confirmed. Verify eligibility, storage, branding, SSL and domain rights on the actual license.

Primary evidence: [How much does it cost? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778289-how-much-does-it-cost).
sections.zh:
专门定价表称 Free 使用 imxprs.com/free/username URL、最多 50 MB、无邮件地址。2019 年费用 FAQ 重复 50 MB 限制，并让自定义域名/更大站点用户订阅。相反，首页和定价页下部文案宣传不限托管/带宽和免费连接域名，首页另有面向学生、艺术家及非营利组织的免费许可申请。申请 URL 此次仅显示登录界面。不能将无限制免费自定义域名托管标为已确认，应在实际许可核对资格、存储、品牌、SSL 和域名权利。

一手依据：[How much does it cost? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778289-how-much-does-it-cost)。

sections.en:
The Premium table shows $9.95/month labeled “Biannual” and $7.95/month for one year, while the homepage rounds Premium to $8/month. The meaning and upfront charge of Biannual are not clarified here. White-label pricing is more inconsistent: the homepage shows $350/month and elsewhere a $500/month starting point, whereas the dedicated pricing and white-label pages state $350/year for the entry offering. Preserve that conflict instead of normalizing a monthly price. The 2019 renewal FAQ says subscriptions renew automatically through BlueSnap; the cost FAQ mentions a 14-day money-back guarantee. Confirm current taxes, renewal term, cancellation deadline and refund eligibility in writing before payment.

Primary evidence: [Renewal Policy | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2873024-renewal-policy).

Primary evidence: [How much does it cost? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778289-how-much-does-it-cost).
sections.zh:
Premium 表显示标注 Biannual 的 $9.95/月和一年期 $7.95/月，首页将其约为 $8/月；此处没有澄清 Biannual 的具体含义及预收金额。白标价格冲突更明显：首页显示 $350/月，另一处说起价 $500/月，而专门定价页和白标页称入门方案 $350/年。应保留冲突，不归一月费。2019 年续费 FAQ 称通过 BlueSnap 自动续费，费用 FAQ 提及 14 天退款保证。付款前应书面确认当前税费、续费周期、取消期限和退款资格。

一手依据：[Renewal Policy | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2873024-renewal-policy)。

一手依据：[How much does it cost? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778289-how-much-does-it-cost)。

sections.title_en: Separate reselling, site hosting and builder hosting
sections.title_zh: 区分转售、站点托管与建站器托管
sections.en: Creator PRO’s entry offer is a fully branded editor and reseller dashboard, with own templates, packages and client logins. The white-label page prices Host it yourself at $500/month for downloadable client sites, API access and hosting those sites on your servers. Servers Control starts at $25,000/year and adds a customized copy of the builder on your server and deeper integration. Automated SSL is described as an additional plan. These are materially different scopes: a downloadable site is not the entire builder, and a white-label license does not transfer unrestricted rights to the platform. Check integration work, payment processing and support responsibility in the contract.
sections.zh: Creator PRO 入门方案是完整品牌化编辑器和转售面板，可设置模板、套餐和客户登录。白标页将 Host it yourself 标为 $500/月，提供客户站点下载、API 及在自有服务器托管这些网站。Servers Control 起价 $25,000/年，再增加自有服务器上的定制建站器及更深集成。自动 SSL 被描述为附加方案。这些范围有实质差异：可下载站点不等于完整建站器，白标许可也不转移平台的无限制权利。合同中应明确集成工作、支付处理和支持责任。

sections.en:
A March 2019 support article offers site files for a one-time $100 fee by contacting support, and separately points to Host It Yourself White Label. Treat this as a dated route to confirm, not a current automatic export entitlement or a guarantee that forms, commerce, login and every integration will work elsewhere. IM Creator may fit a visual brochure site or a reseller who accepts its license and hosted workflow. A developer needing independent application source, stable self-service export or a complete backend migration should resolve those requirements first. No editor, license application, checkout, DNS or export was executed here.

Primary evidence: [Can I host my site somewhere else? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778255-can-i-host-my-site-somewhere-else).
sections.zh:
2019 年 3 月支持文章称可联系支持，以一次性 $100 获得站点文件，并另指向 Host It Yourself 白标方案。这是需重新确认的旧文档路径，不是当前自动导出权利，也不保证表单、电商、登录及全部集成在其他主机正常运行。接受其许可和托管流程的展示站或转售商可将 IM Creator 纳入候选；需要独立应用源码、稳定自助导出或完整后端迁移的开发者应先解决这些要求。本次未执行编辑器、许可申请、结账、DNS 或导出。

一手依据：[Can I host my site somewhere else? | IM Creator Help CenterIntercom](https://intercom.help/imcreator/en/articles/2778255-can-i-host-my-site-somewhere-else)。
